catchment._source: guess: one nightclub ~ 2.5 pubs; 100 hotel rooms ~ 1 pub; a station ~ 2 pubs

demand._hour_source: mean of NTA time-of-last-trip bands Feb 2022, Feb 2024 (Fare Review 2024 p.36) and Feb 2026 (Consumer Survey p.25), % per hour; hours 00-04 belong to the previous evening's service day
demand._kernel_source: guess: a trigger counts from 45 min before (ramping to full at 15 min before, so a driver can arrive ahead of the crowd), stays full to 30 min after, gone by 60 min after
demand._venue_source: guess scaled to capacity: Aviva ~51k and Croke Park ~82k = 3; 3Arena ~13k = 1.5; RDS halls and League of Ireland grounds = 0.5
demand._weekday_source: NTA Taxi Consumer Survey 2026 p.23, day of most recent trip, Mon..Sun (%)

logger._gap_source: guess: a gap of more than 2 min between the last fix at the stand and the departure means the wait ended somewhere in the gap (end stamped at last sighting, censored)

notes: Every number here is a guess until drivers log real waits (ADR 0002). Values are set only so that obvious extremes rank the right way (Task 6 tests), and each one is labelled with where it came from.

rank._source: guess: each km away halves-to-thirds a rank's appeal (score / (1 + km/k)); k=2 sent a Ballsbridge driver 3.4 km to Dame Street during an Aviva let-out
